showcases.name: Barnard's Star
showcases.note: 10.4 arcsec/yr: about 270 arcsec north of its J2000 position in 2026, so a 5 arcmin field centred on the J2000 position MISSES it. Saturates (V 9.5, J 5.2).

showcases.name: Epsilon Indi B (brown dwarf pair)
showcases.note: Brown dwarf pair Ba/Bb, 0.7 arcsec apart, so unresolved at 6.15 arcsec. About 400 arcsec from Epsilon Indi A, so A is outside a 5 arcmin field. About 1.1 px of motion over the data so far: needs centroiding, not eyeballing.

showcases.name: WISE 0855
showcases.note: Moved about 125 arcsec (20 px) west since the brief's position. Y4 dwarf, J 25: expect it only in the longest channels, if at all.

showcases.name: R Draconis
showcases.note: Mira variable near the north ecliptic pole: about 2,400 frames in 35 visits.

showcases.name: RW Aurigae
showcases.note: Young variable binary. Bright: check saturation.
